verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library, not itself a natural-language interface, but dltHub ships an AI Harness (skills, rules, MCP servers) and an official MCP server exposing tools to inspect/query/manage pipelines, letting coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) be driven via natural language to build and operate pipelines. This is agent-mediated NL operation rather than a native NL command layer in dlt itself. Missing for 10: no first-party natural-language CLI/chat interface within dlt itself, no independent hands-on evidence of NL command reliability, and coverage is limited to agent/MCP integration rather than universal NL control of all dlt operations.
